title: Twilio SDK v4 migration: SMS API restructure and Programmable Fax deprecation

changes.description: `twilio.messages` usage is being consolidated; the Programmable SMS API surface is deprecated in favor of the unified Messages API.

fix.explain: Namespace the client under messages.v1 in the v4 SDK.

changes.description: Programmable Fax (POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Fax.json) is deprecated and will be sunset.

fix.explain: Migrate fax usage to a supported channel (email/SMS via Messages API) before the sunset date.

changes.description: Twilio SDK v4 introduced the new client structure; v3 clients are unsupported.

fix.explain: Upgrade twilio to ^4.0.0 and migrate the client initialization.
